messages:
Ivy Chen: Quick check — I updated the threshold expression helper copy. Current tooltip says: 'Trigger when error rate > threshold for window'. Kinda terse.
Miles Carter: Can we show concrete examples instead? e.g., 'Example: 5% errors for 5m' and a link to 'Show more examples'.
Zoe Patel: Love examples. Also add a short explainer for operators: does 'for 5m' mean sustained for the entire 5 minutes or any 5m sliding window? Users ask this all the time.
Samir Gupta: Backend semantics: it's a sliding window with evaluation every 30s and requires state to be true for the full window unless "burst" mode is enabled. We should surface that succinctly.
Ivy Chen: Proposed tooltip copy: 'Triggers when condition holds across a sliding window (evaluated every 30s). e.g., "5% errors for 5m" means error rate >=5% continuously for 5 minutes.' Thoughts?
a11y-bot: Tooltip accessibility: ensure tooltip is reachable via keyboard (focus on helper icon) and the text is exposed to screen readers. Use role="tooltip" and aria-describedby.
Zoe Patel: Microcopy tweak: use 'continuously' -> 'for the duration' (simpler). Also add a small inline example toggle: 'Show sample event stream' that expands with a 6-line ASCII timeline.
Miles Carter: Example timeline (good for tooltip expansion):
```
00:00  OK
00:30  6% errors
01:00  5% errors
01:30  5% errors -> condition met after 5m
```
Samir Gupta: Keep the evaluation frequency note short: 'evaluated every 30s' is fine. For advanced docs link, add anchor to 'evaluation semantics'.
Ivy Chen: Also thinking about threshold input labeling. Right now it's 'Threshold'. Maybe 'SLO threshold / alert condition' is clearer. But long labels hurt layout. Suggest 'Alert condition' as the label and a sublabel 'e.g., 5% for 5m'.
Zoe Patel: For mobile/responsive, hide examples by default and show a 'Examples' link.
a11y-bot: Contrast and font size: helper text must meet 4.5:1 for body copy. Also ensure the expanded example timeline uses monospace and is announced properly when opened.
Miles Carter: One more: internationalization. Percent vs fraction examples differ. Use '5% (0.05) for 5m' in the advanced view.
Ivy Chen: Great. I'll update the tooltip copy and the expanded example UI. I'll push new artboard and the small ASCII timeline to the doc. Linking now: https://drive.redwood/design/threshold-tooltip-examples
design-bot: Reminder: add final copy to the spec doc before review tomorrow 2pm PT.
Ivy Chen: Thanks team, closing thread.
